summary: Link SDK capture and journal through one-shot exact attempt context

delivery.outcome: Link each captured direct SDK attempt to its exact journal record through a one-shot context-local identity-bound reference, preserving provider results on telemetry failure.
nonGoals: No route, provider, budget, historical join, reserved router path, or protected policy edits. No raw payloads in journals or progress.

architecture.decision: Existing begin/finish capture carries the raw attempt identity on an internal record wrapper. A context-local one-shot reference is consumed by record_attempt only when the entire request/application/function/provider/model identity matches. Explicit archive_ref retains precedence. New attempts and failed capture boundaries clear stale metadata. Preserve the existing two-element capture entry and journal schema.

dataChanges.description: Populate the existing optional archive_id/day fields on the same local attempt journal. No schema change, data migration or responsibility transfer.

architecture.rollback: Revert source and select the prior qualified SDK. Existing exact refs remain readable; no database downgrade.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_sdk_archive_link.py tests/test_usage.py tests/test_gateway.py tests/test_native_transports.py tests/test_postgres_interaction_store.py
validation.evidence: Private subllm-sdk-archive-link-20261028 receipts; affected Testless coverage, protected full CI and independent validation; runtime selection remains separate.
